title: Concept: Apache error log served as a response
description: Error log lines carry the failing path, the module that failed and the exception message. They are the most direct description of how the application breaks, and they often include the query or the file that could not be opened.
applicability: Responses that serve the log directory from the web root.
risk: The caller learns the filesystem layout and the failure modes of the application, which shortens the path to a working exploit.
